title: Bodhi Tree Systems (backed by James Murdoch's Lupa Systems and Uday Shankar) agrees to buy a majority stake in Chennai's Adyar Ananda Bhavan (A2B) for $180 million (over ₹1,600 crore), announced 12 Nov 2026; stake size and closing date undisclosed; ~160 outlets in India, 30+ abroad, 15,000+ staff; Shankar to chair the new board; expansion to western India and Europe, factory upgrades in Chennai and Bengaluru, possible listing (no date); Bodhi Tree's third investment after ALLEN and JioStar
